html:
Usain Bolt, born in Trelawny, Jamaica, in 1986, is a sprinter who holds the world records for the 100 metres (9.58 seconds) and 200 metres (19.19 seconds), both set in Berlin in 2009.

He won eight Olympic gold medals at Beijing, London and Rio between 2008 and 2016, including the 100 and 200 metres at three Games in a row. His speed and showmanship made him one of the most famous athletes of his time.

He came out of the strong school sprint culture of Jamaica, which has produced many world class runners such as Shelly-Ann Fraser-Pryce. With Bob Marley and reggae, he is among the best known faces of Jamaica around the world.
